# GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services

## Overview

Build a 5-page corporate website for **GlobalStone**, a global leader in commercial real estate services and investments. The site targets commercial real estate investors, occupiers, property owners, and corporate clients. It must project authority, sophistication, and scale — think CBRE or JLL-level polish. The tone is **professional, modern, and elegant** throughout.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Deep navy (#0A1628) as the primary dark tone, paired with white, cool grays, and a refined accent — gold or teal — for CTAs and highlights. Avoid anything playful or startup-ish.
- **Typography:** Use a clean sans-serif (e.g., Inter or similar) for body text and a slightly bolder weight or contrasting serif for headlines to convey gravitas.
- **Imagery mood:** Use placeholder images suggesting skylines, modern office towers, and architectural interiors. Large hero images with subtle overlays set the tone on every page.
- **Spacing & layout:** Generous whitespace, structured grids, and clear visual hierarchy. This is a content-rich site — clarity is paramount.

## Key Priorities

1. **The mega menu navigation** is the most complex interactive element. On desktop, hovering/clicking "Services" must reveal a well-organized dropdown with service categories and property types. On mobile, this collapses into accordion-style navigation. Get this right — it's the primary wayfinding mechanism across all 5 pages.

2. **The "What We Do" tabbed section** on the homepage (vertical tabs switching content panels) is a signature interaction that must feel smooth and polished.

3. **Service detail pages** (Invest/Finance/Value, Plan/Lease/Occupy, Design & Build) each have capabilities grids — these must be scannable, consistent in structure, and link logically back to the services overview.

4. **The homepage is dense** — hero, featured insights, announcement banner, about statement, services preview, newsletter CTA, latest insights, and commitment pillars. Prioritize visual rhythm so it doesn't feel overwhelming.

The site must be fully responsive with no build step required.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

Transaction Services

Landlord Representation

Workforce & Location Analytics

Design & Build

From Concept to Occupancy — Delivered With Precision

GlobalStone examines every aspect of your business or investment strategy to plan, design, develop, and deliver real estate — integrating architecture, engineering, and construction expertise under one accountable platform.

Explore Capabilities

Overview

Integrated Project Delivery for Every Scale and Sector

GlobalStone's Design & Build practice delivers end-to-end project management and construction services that transform real estate visions into fully realized, high-performing spaces. Our integrated approach coordinates every stakeholder — architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors — to ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to specification.

From a single workplace fit-out to a multi-country campus development, our experienced teams apply disciplined program management and strategic procurement to maximize value at every stage.

Our Capabilities

01

Project & Program Management

End-to-end oversight of construction and renovation projects, from feasibility and design coordination through delivery and closeout. Our project managers serve as the single point of accountability — managing risk, schedule, budget, and quality across every phase of the project lifecycle.

We deploy proven methodologies and integrated technology platforms to ensure real-time visibility into project status, cost performance, and schedule adherence for every stakeholder.

Learn More →

02

Supply Chain Sourcing

Strategic procurement and vendor management that reduce costs, mitigate risk, and accelerate project timelines. GlobalStone's global supply chain network provides access to preferred pricing, pre-qualified contractors, and expedited material sourcing across 100+ markets.

Our sourcing specialists identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs, strengthen contract terms, and improve supply chain resilience — without compromising quality or sustainability standards.

Learn More →

Our Delivery Process

01

Strategy & Feasibility

Define project objectives, constraints, and success criteria — establishing the business case and delivery roadmap.

02

Design & Planning

Coordinate architecture, MEP, and structural engineering to develop compliant, efficient, and inspiring design solutions.

03

Procurement

Competitively tender and award contracts, leveraging our global supply chain network to optimize cost and schedule.

04

Construction & Delivery

Active on-site management and quality assurance — driving milestones, resolving issues, and protecting your investment.

05

Handover & Activation

Structured commissioning, punch-list resolution, and occupancy readiness — ensuring a seamless transition from build to use.

Global Design & Build Network

Partnership Highlight

A Global Network of Delivery Partners

GlobalStone's Design & Build division partners with leading architecture, engineering, and construction firms worldwide to deliver turnkey solutions.

Our integrated approach ensures seamless coordination from concept through occupancy — eliminating costly handoffs, reducing rework, and maintaining a single point of accountability throughout the project lifecycle.

18% Average timeline reduction vs. traditional delivery
12% Average cost savings delivered to clients
500+ Projects delivered annually worldwide
100+ Countries in our delivery network
Learn About Our Partners

Start Your Next Project

Whether you're planning a new headquarters, repositioning an asset, or rolling out a global workplace program, GlobalStone's Design & Build team is ready to deliver.

All 7 files are in place. The GlobalStone website is complete — 5 HTML pages + shared CSS + shared JS totaling ~2,900 lines.

**What was built:**

| File | Page |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Homepage — hero, featured insights, announcement banner, about statement, What We Do tabs, newsletter, latest insights, commitment pillars |

| `services-design-build.html` | Design & Build — 2-cap cards, 5-step process, partnership highlight with metrics, CTA |
| `shared.css` | Full design system: colors, typography, buttons, header, footer, mega menu |
| `shared.js` | Mega menu toggle, mobile accordion, What We Do tabs, carousel, scroll shadow |

- **Mega menu** — hover/click on "Services" opens a 3-column dropdown (By Need / By Property Type / Featured card); closes on Escape, outside click, or mouse-leave
- **Mobile accordion** — hamburger menu with collapsible Services sub-nav
- **What We Do tabs** — vertical tab switching between Insights, Services, and Careers panels
- **Partner carousel** — prev/next controls and dot navigation with smooth CSS transitions
- **Newsletter form** — email input with styled Subscribe button
